newsitem.title: UK: Bluebird gains on Mattel bid for Tyco.
newsitem.headline: Bluebird gains on Mattel bid for Tyco.

text.p: Shares in Bluebird Toys Plc rose on Monday as Mattel Inc's $755 million bid for Tyco Toys Inc revived bid speculation around the maker of Polly Pocket toys, traders said.
Bluebird shares were up 14-1/2p at 181 by 1445 GMT, after earlier touching a three-month high of 183p.
"We had thought the stock could have a pre-Christmas run but today we also have the Mattel bid," said one trader.

Bluebird shares had plunged in early August as the company posted a sharp fall in pre-tax profits for the first half of the year and warned that harsh world market conditions were having an adverse effect on the current year's performance.
Share in Tyco leapt more than 50 percent in pre-market trading in New York after news of Mattel's bid.
